scope: N1 RHI/backends/CTS, raster, shader and its host rules: canonical ownership, same-package legacy entries, generated shaders, independent source/archive consumers and actual backend/website regressions.

initial_failure.cause: An emitted C++ string assertion still expected omui::rhi after the emitter migrated to mlibs::rhi.
initial_failure.resolution: Updated the expected canonical generated API; shader-dev-final passes all 11 shader cases.

totals.note: Final native selection combines the three gfx libraries, SDL backend and nine consumers. Repeated shader assertions from the initial failing invocation are not double-counted. Program basenames can repeat in different packages; counts are program executions, not unique feature counts. Browser and external consumers are separate.

implementation_normalization.scope: Runtime and rule implementation bodies compared to HEAD after explicit module/namespace/memory qualification/generated path normalization. Public forwarding entries are new; manifests and generator build.mcpp are reviewed separately.

limits: Source compatibility after rebuild; not C++ binary ABI compatibility or registry aliases.
Native release source and archive consumers; this gate does not test other targets.
Fresh consumer build times can reuse global toolchain caches; they are not clean-machine benchmarks.
The packed consumer explicitly declares foundation dependencies, hanim.core and external index dependencies.
Shader provisioning is tested on this machine; relocation of the recorded Slang tool path is not verified.
mcpp index lock hashes describe namespace/name/version, not downloaded artifact content.
No package publication or claim that mcpp pack preserves dependency metadata.

consumer_audit_corrections: Allow only the shader package outDir/mlibs/slang_provisioned.cppm generated module, with its expected exported partition and recorded hash.

Classify the shader CLI entry separately from runtime implementation units and require its object to be absent from the actual consumer link. The CLI is compiled by mcpp even when consuming the library.
Parse Ninja output tokens before the colon rather than assuming no whitespace before it; runtime consumer assertions were already passing when this audit assumption failed.

limits: N1 content, N2 engines and N3 UI/spec migration remain incomplete. No S1-S10 or 40/20 functional acceptance is added by renaming.
Legacy namespace aliases cannot be reopened. Source compatibility requires rebuilding; no C++ ABI/BMI, old CLI selector or registry alias guarantee.
Packed dependencies are explicit in the fixture; top-level-only package installation and relocated Slang compiler provisioning remain unverified.
Linux GCC16 and Emscripten/Chromium checked locally. Windows, macOS, mobile and hardware GPU qualification are not claimed.
GPU checks use software Vulkan/SwiftShader. The documented WebGPU presentation retry is an environment-specific limitation.
Native shader compiler/process loading is tested on the build host; generated WGSL/ESSL run in the browser. No claim that this compiler runs inside Wasm.
Process sampling does not alone prove realtime cadence or aesthetic quality. Whole-page screenshots contain live timing; only fixed canvas samples and hanim PNGs are compared byte-for-byte.
Fresh external projects may reuse global compiler caches; timings and package/wasm sizes are observations, not a clean-machine performance comparison.
